blocks.text: BALANGA CITY, Bataan — A 60-year-old woman riding a tricycle was reportedly killed when a speeding pickup truck rammed into the vehicle at 9 p.m. on Sunday, Nov. 22, police said. The passenger died on the spot. READ: Woman killed, 2 injured in Pangasinan tricycle crash The tricycle, driven by Carolina Wagan, had slowed down and was about to turn left toward Barangay Central when the pickup truck plowed into it. Instead of helping the victim, the pickup truck driver sped away. Balanga police officers are tracking the whereabouts of the vehicle involved in the accident. /mcm...
